record.label: Spacetime cost and error of the Häner baseline
record.statement: For Häner et al.’s $(35,3,3)$ configuration, the paper estimates the cost of the two dominant reversible subcircuits using 245 qubits and $440{,}576$ $T$ gates. It reports a maximum error of approximately $10^{-6}$.
record.boundary: The two dominant subcircuits give $245\times440{,}576=107{,}941{,}120$. Appendix F.2 omits persistent registers and the smaller branch-selection and combination circuits from this estimate.
